patch.value: GH-1625: align extension-refusal Sentry capture with declared contracts and telemetry source context

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1625 identifies handled pm-presets SimulationRefusal events from host2026.10.25 in production Sentry without telemetry source_context. Investigate the documented extension-refusal boundary and provenance propagation; distinguish authorized declared refusals from unexpected exceptions instead of suppressing every object with a code. Retain unknown/unhandled fault admission and verify the actual emitting host/package versions. This producer concern is separate from upstream SDK resolution and the release-blocker investigation.

Reproduce through real extension host and classify only validated declared refusal contracts; Preserve capture of unknown codes mismatched contracts and unexpected or unhandled exceptions; Verify privacy-safe source_context host version and extension version propagation; Prove test isolation and fresh live telemetry without resolving historical faults solely to clear a gate

Sentry distinguishes documented expected extension refusals from unexpected faults and carries privacy-safe source context and version provenance consistent with telemetry, without weakening release fault detection.
